# Dial-A-Dead

> Stream every Grateful Dead live show from the Internet Archive — free, legal, and complete. Enter any date from 1965–1995 and that night's concert plays straight from archive.org.

Dial-A-Dead is a web player for the entire Grateful Dead live archive: 2,000+ concert dates drawn from 18,000+ archive.org recordings. Soundboards are preferred over audience tapes, and every recording of a night (soundboard, matrix, audience) is selectable. Features: setlists, random show, today-in-history, saved favourites, previous/next show, and single-track or whole-show downloads. No accounts, no ads. Audio is served by the Internet Archive under the Grateful Dead's taper-friendly policy.

## Pages

- [Player](https://dialadead.com/): enter a date and stream the show
- [Open a show in the player](https://dialadead.com/?date=1977-05-08): any date as `?date=YYYY-MM-DD`
- [Show page](https://dialadead.com/show/1977-05-08): one concert's venue, city, recording type, songs and play link; any date as `/show/YYYY-MM-DD`
- [Year page](https://dialadead.com/year/1977): every show from one year; any year 1965–1995 as `/year/YYYY`
- [Sitemap](https://dialadead.com/sitemap.xml): every year and show page

## Data

- [Show index](https://dialadead.com/shows.json): JSON of every date with its recommended archive.org recording, venue, city and source type
- [Grateful Dead collection on archive.org](https://archive.org/details/GratefulDead): the source of all audio

## Optional

- [NeonDeadhead](https://neondeadhead.com): the people behind the site
